Hands-on work. Precision handling. A direct contribution to advanced technology. As a Cleanroom Logistics Operator in ASML's FOUP & Reticle department, you ensure that essential materials and tools arrive safely, cleanly and on time where they are needed. 
You handle specialised items such as FOUPs and reticles. FOUPs are containers that protect wafers from contamination and damage during storage and transport. Reticles are highly precise glass plates carrying the patterns used in the lithography process. These delicate materials require careful handling, and you help keep them protected and available for production. 
This is a largely hands-on role with a smaller administrative component. You work in a controlled cleanroom, wear protective clothing and follow strict hygiene and safety procedures. Working a five-shift schedule, including early, late and night shifts, you support the continuity of production together with your colleagues. 
Your responsibilities include: - Transporting materials, tools, FOUPs and reticles within the cleanroom and to production departments. - Handling delicate components carefully to prevent contamination or damage. - Checking materials for completeness and quality, and reporting discrepancies. - Packing and preparing components for assembly or testing. - Recording inventory movements and the issue and return of materials. - Following cleanroom procedures, work instructions and safety requirements. - Coordinating with production and logistics colleagues to keep materials available. - Supporting the smooth operation of machines and assembly processes. 
Dutch is not required. English-speaking candidates are welcome to apply. Functie-eisen
